description: Prior notification for change of use from coffee shop to restaurant and cafes for the sale of food and drink for consumption on the premises - restaurants, snack bars and cafes.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([Design and Access Statement], [Technical Specification for Installation Extraction System], [Flakt Woods Limited Technical Data Sheet], [HB/149/02], [HB/VAL/131/01-Existing], [HB/VAL/131/01-Proposed], Received: 30/06/2020 [Noise Report], Received: 03/11/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 2.	Prior to the first use or occupation of the development hereby permitted, a secure space for at least one cycle shall be provided inside the building's footprint and shall be made available at all times thereafter for the purposes of staff cycle parking.

Condition : 4 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or 1 meter from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria is achieved. 
b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter. 
c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review.

Condition : 5 - Delivery and collection times (including refuse) for commercial premises, which are situated in or very near to residential areas shall only be carried out between the following hours: Monday to Saturday between 07:00 and 22:00, Sunday between 09:00 to 20:00.

Condition : 6 - 5.	Prior to the first use or occupation of the hereby approved development, details of a refuse strategy shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The strategy shall detail how the refuse will be stored on the site and collected to avoid harming the street scene and obstructing pedestrians, and details of how the rear servicing road will be managed to prevent car being parked on it so that is it available for its intended use. Refuse management shall thereafter be carried out in strict accordance with the approved strategy for the duration of the development.

Condition : 7 - 6.	The development hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with the submitted 'Technical Specification for Installation Extractor System' with regards to odour mitigation, and shall be retained as such throughout the lifetime of the development.
